messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “2D Pocket Stardew Valley with a 3×3 farm and seasons” game.

## Requirements
- Deliver the playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport at most 1280px wide, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with canvas-drawn farm artwork and localStorage saves.
- Seasons rotate every seven days; crops need daily watering, can be harvested for gold, and out-of-season crops fade when the season changes.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a responsive, playable game in `index.html` with a 3×3 farm, tools, seasonal seeds, energy, gold, crop growth, harvests, season changes, help modal, and save persistence.
- Checked JavaScript syntax with `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Playwright and saved/inspected `screenshots/farm.jpg`.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. (none)

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/farm.jpg`: Latest visual check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Playwright reported only a missing `favicon.ico` 404 on initial load.
